overview: Grimling Encampments is the military heart of Grimling Forest, where warbands gather, shamans perform rituals, and Acrylia-tainted leaders command raids.
history: Grimling tribes unified under war-chiefs after discovering Acrylia fragments.
Encampments formed around bonfires and beast pens as warbands grew.
Shamans began performing rituals to empower warriors with forest spirits.
Acrylia corruption seeped into the encampments through scavenged crystal shards.
Seru scouts attempted to disrupt the encampments but were repelled.
hooks: A war-chief prepares a massive raid.
Shamans attempt a dangerous empowerment ritual.
Acrylia shards corrupt a beast pen.
